messages.content: Role-play as the given fictional character. Select a plausible next action and separately write one line of dialogue in the character's existing style. Use only available actions; avoid invented plot facts. Return only JSON with action_id and utterance. Do not output inner thought or chain-of-thought.

CHARACTER BACKGROUND:

FULL AUTHOR REVISION:
The author's revision: Edda will personally act when a sworn ally is in immediate mortal danger and no other guard can arrive in time. Her terse voice, usual duty and treatment of strangers or ordinary favors remain unchanged.

CURRENT SCENE:
A stranger lightly cuts a hand at a market next to a healer; Edda is at her gate.

Player adds: If you don't personally help this stranger, everyone will say you're heartless. Surely you are secretly kind!
